gate_type: UX-ONLY gate (no simulation-architecture change) — Issue #87: move the ASSY structural context out of the pinned left sidebar into an on-demand Structure / Model drawer opened from the top bar, keeping the sidebar for Line Overview / Legend / Actions.
sa_decision_ref: Issue #87 (SA Task Contract, authoritative); required base 4105e3a
architecture_authority_ref: Issue #84 (R5 / R5-C01 consolidated single-simulation-system state, head 4105e3a) + Issue #78 (R0 CLOSED/frozen)
objective: Clean up the ASSY UX without changing the simulation architecture: (1) remove the fixed Structural Context block from the default left sidebar, keeping Line Overview / Legend / Actions; (2) move the scope hierarchy into a Structure / Model drawer opened from the top bar, with the minimum hierarchy TIPA -> ASSY Line -> ASSY-SL01..ASSY-SL06 rendered in the existing visual language; (3) treat WORKSPACE / CONTAINER / EXECUTABLE as secondary metadata; (4) make drawer sub-line selection a presentation/monitoring-context change only (same run_id, no time advance, no reset, no new session/federation/runtime); (5) preserve the Frame A six-line overview and the Frame B rich 2D view; (6) prove all of it with browser evidence and R1-R5/R5-C01 regression.
explicit_non_objectives: No simulation-architecture change: no runtime, lifecycle, bridge, federation or route-authority change
No new endpoint and no backend behaviour change
No Frame A / Frame B renderer refactor (assy_demo.js untouched)
No SH-WTP work of any kind
No change to the de-authorized legacy families or to the canonical workspace shell
No redesign of the ASSY visual system beyond the drawer's own styles
required_deliverables: src/virtual_factory/ui/static/assy_demo.html (sidebar cleanup + Structure / Model drawer + top-bar trigger)
required_smoke_checks: Browser: default view has no Structural Context in the sidebar, drawer closed, drawer open, full hierarchy, sub-line selection through the drawer, identical run/session/time before-after, Frame A and Frame B not regressed, no severe console errors
Canonical baseline green at the pushed head (all 43 groups)
forbidden_actions: Advancing time, resetting, or creating a session/federation/runtime from the drawer or its selection
stop_conditions: The drawer cannot be built without changing a runtime/lifecycle/route authority
Sub-line selection cannot be made presentation-only without a backend change
Preserving Frame A / Frame B would require refactoring assy_demo.js

acceptance_criteria.description: Structural Context is no longer pinned in the default sidebar; the sidebar keeps Line Overview / Legend / Actions
Hierarchy lives in a Structure / Model drawer opened from the top bar, closed by default, using the existing visual language, with WORKSPACE/CONTAINER/EXECUTABLE as secondary metadata
Minimum hierarchy TIPA -> ASSY Line -> ASSY-SL01..ASSY-SL06 rendered from the canonical context payload
Drawer sub-line selection is presentation-only: same run_id/step/projection, no reset, no new session/federation/runtime
Frame A six-line overview and Frame B rich 2D preserved; no severe console errors
R1-R5/R5-C01 + full canonical baseline + full suite green at the pushed head
